name: Lentil and Tomato Soup
method: Heat the oil in a pan and soften the chopped onion and carrot for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 30 seconds, then add the lentils, passata and 350 ml water.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft and starting to collapse. Season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into a bowl and serve hot.
